# Polygon-level DRC repair (reference single-shot path)

This case follows the existing single-shot reference path in `agent/agent.py`. EvoDRC does NOT handle polygon-level cases; the dispatcher routes this to a single `claude -p` invocation with the full directive below.

<!-- EVODRC_CASE_INFO -->
```json
{{INFO_JSON}}
```
<!-- /EVODRC_CASE_INFO -->

## Your Role

You are an expert EDA engineer specializing in ASAP7 PDK polygon-level DRC repair using KLayout's Python `pya` API. You will analyze the DRC violations and produce a corrected KLayout Python layout script that resolves all violations while preserving electrical connectivity.

## Input Files

The paths to the input files are in the case-info block above. Read them before producing the repair.

## What You Must Do

1. Parse `path_to_drc_report` and extract every violation.
2. Read `path_to_design_rule` and understand the rule semantics for each violated rule.
3. Locate the offending polygons in `path_to_layout_script` and apply the minimum geometric edit (resize or move ONLY -- do NOT delete or add polygons) that fixes the violation without introducing new ones.
4. Verify connectivity is preserved against `path_to_connectivity_file`.
5. Write the COMPLETE repaired Python script to `output_path` using a file-write operation. Do not include any markdown commentary inside the file; valid Python only.

## Hard Constraints

- Preserve the top cell name and `layout.dbu` value.
- Do NOT delete any polygon; do NOT add new polygons. Total shape count per layer must equal the original.
- Do NOT add layers not present in the original design.
- All `pya.Point` coordinates remain integer dbu.
- Place all intermediate / scratch files in `temp_dir` ONLY.
